set.body: Distill the Zarr-based neuroimaging discussion into a repository-grounded plan. Treat NeuroArchive as the semantic umbrella; define HDF5 and Zarr storage profiles, BIDS compatibility, ScalaFIM versus Eidolon ownership, phased deliverables, conformance and performance gates, risks, and the first executable slice. Deliver only docs/plans/neuroarchive-data-access.md; do not alter active implementation work.
set.title: Plan NeuroArchive Next data access
